subscriptions.name: ChatGPT Pro / eligible Business
subscriptions.finding: Pro tiers ($100, $200, $500) and eligible Business subscribers get monthly API credits equal to the tier; the grant funds one linked API organization; ChatGPT and API billing stay separate; Plus and free trials do not qualify; the subscription must be active for 7 days before claiming.

subscriptions.name: Claude Max / Ultra / Team
subscriptions.finding: Max ($100 per month), Ultra ($200), Team Standard ($20 per seat) and Team Premium ($100 per seat) get monthly Claude API credits after linking one Console organization (7 days on the plan). Free, Pro and Enterprise are not eligible. The credits cover the Claude API, not Bedrock or Vertex. Anthropic has no speech-to-text API on the pages read, so these credits do not pay for transcription.

subscriptions.name: Google AI Pro
subscriptions.finding: UNVERIFIED: a search summary said it includes $10 per month of Google Cloud credits for the Gemini API; the Google page returned almost nothing and forum posts say the credits did not work in AI Studio (user-reported). Do not rely on it.

subscriptions.name: Hugging Face PRO
subscriptions.finding: $2.00 per month of compute credits, shared across HF compute services and usable for Inference Providers requests routed through HF.

expiries.what: Mistral deprecates Voxtral Mini Transcribe 2 (voxtral-mini-2602) in favour of Voxtral Mini Transcribe 3
OpenAI shuts down gpt-4o-transcribe, gpt-4o-mini-transcribe, gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize and whisper-1 (gpt-transcribe is the replacement)

notes: tier is the maintainers' suggested order among models that fit (judgement, not a benchmark); word timestamps are what subtitles need. vram_basis says stated, estimate or user-reported.
